contexts.text: They looked out to the faces of Sodom () = the state of the human race.
The men looked out thence () = the Lord's thought from the Divine... To look out = to think, Explained. AC 2684.
Abimelech... looked out through a window () = the doctrine of faith looking to rational things...
The looking forward of the Natural. Signified, Explained. AC 5289.
He looked out hither and thither, and saw that there was no man () = prudence as to whether he was in safety.
Jehovah looked out to the camp of the Egyptians () = the extension thence of the Divine influx... Explained.
It is not contrary to order to look out for one's self and others.
Its lookout was to the end of the earth () = its extension even to the ultimates of the Church.
